title: Comedians Han Solo, William Boeva and Erhan Demirci tour together in 'Our Tour'
description-1: After fifteen years on stage, comedian Han Coucke, better known as Han Solo, is beginning to question whether his humor still has a place in today's comedy landscape. The idea of quitting is in the air, but first he wants to go on tour with his best friends to celebrate his anniversary.
description-2: In the new series 'Onzen Tour', Han Solo, William Boeva, and Erhan Demirci travel across Flanders for a number of try-out shows. What starts as a tour quickly turns into a road trip filled with humor and unexpected moments between friends. The series offers a behind-the-scenes look at the world of stand-up comedy and a glimpse into a fifteen-year, unrestrained friendship.
